global_style: A modern, academic presentation template featuring a soothing Morandi pastel color palette, organic wavy borders, and terrazzo speckle accents.

identity_anchors: Organic, fluid, wavy color-blocked shapes framing the slide corners.
Terrazzo-style speckled dots clustered primarily in the bottom-left corner.
Elevated rounded-rectangle badges with soft drop shadows for section numbering.
Delicate, minimalist outline icons centered in circular nodes.

density_rules.low: Use one focal idea and generous whitespace.
density_rules.medium: Use two to six concise content groups on the observed grid.
density_rules.high: Remove decoration before reducing label size or hierarchy.

variation_rules: Vary image/text balance and emphasis while preserving anchors, grid, and color ratios.
anti_repetition_rules: Do not repeat the same primary composition or decoration placement on adjacent slides.
